items.title: What Are Claude Code Mods?
items.summary: Claude Code mods are small functions that run inside Claude Code and can let an action through, change it, or stop it before it happens. Skills, hooks and MCP servers can't do that, because they sit outside Claude Code. The full video shows how to install mods and the custom Claude Code I built with them: https://youtu.be/XaYubuLtW8M #ClaudeCode #ClaudeMods #Anthropic #AIAgents #codingagents

items.title: Claude Mods - The Biggest Claude Code Upgrade!
items.summary: Claude Code mods let you run your own JavaScript or TypeScript functions inside Claude Code. A mod can watch, change or stop a tool call before it runs, and it can draw its own panels in the terminal and the desktop app. In this video I explain what a Claude Code mod is and how it differs from hooks, skills and MCP servers. Then I show how to install mods from a marketplace and how I had Claude write a set of mods for my own workflow. The session-audit prompt I use (by Vox): https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2105778540251644176 Claude Code mods docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods Getting started with Claude Code mods: https://claude.dev/blog/getting-started-with-claude-code-mods Mods walkthrough by Lydia Hallie (Claude Code team): https://x.com/lydiahallie/status/2106127556491821499 Claude Code changelog: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md DeepSeek Harness: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness Mods run on your machine with your permissions. Read a mod, or run claude plugin validate on it, before you install it. items.title: How a Dell Director Picks His AI Model
items.summary: In episode 1031 of the SuperDataScience podcast, @JonKrohnLearns discusses with Ish Shah, Director at Dell how he selects the best AI model for specific tasks, weighing factors like speed, depth, and enterprise adoption. Ish shares his preferences for Grok, Codex, and Claude based on their unique strengths. This clip offers valuable insights into practical AI model selection from an industry expert.

items.title: How Salesforce Untangled Its Own Data Chaos
items.summary: In episode 1032 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Michael Andrew, CDO at Salesforce how Salesforce tackled its internal data chaos, including duplicate records and disparate systems, leading to the development and deployment of their Data 360 product. Michael explains how they unified customer data from various sources like Snowflake, Amazon data lake, and multiple Salesforce instances to create a single, actionable customer view. This integration now allows their sales team to receive proactive alerts, such as when a customer is about to run out of credits, demonstrating the power of a connected data strategy.
